testsuite.name: com.systemwebstudio.wiring.persistence.JdbcPersistenceTests

testcase.name: a name is unique per tenant but may repeat across tenants()
a definition for a data source of another tenant is refused by the database()
a snapshot for a data source of another tenant is refused by the database()
the binding reader only answers for a project whose workspace owns the project and the source()
credentials are tenant-scoped ciphertext and never part of a normal data source read()
a definition is only replaced by a newer version()
a binding cannot point at a data source of another tenant or workspace()
a data source round-trips and is invisible to another tenant()
a workspace-scoped lookup finds only the source of that tenant and workspace()
another tenant cannot overwrite a data source by reusing its id()
queries and mutations round-trip, are scoped by tenant and data source, and a disabled one is not found()
a data source without a workspace is allowed, one in another tenant's workspace is refused by the database()
TEST and LIVE bindings are separate, default-deny and tenant-scoped, and the reader never writes()
saving needs a newer version, a stale or repeated save is a conflict and changes nothing()
schema snapshots are immutable per version, newest first, tenant-scoped()
a stored definition that no longer validates is not found and does not break the list()
put replaces and a value that is not ciphertext is refused()
